description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Covered Porch, Balcony, and Backyard Patio * 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 mile (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Pet Friendly (add'l fee $250)* Gourmet kitchen, spacious outdoor living areas, and large backyard perfect for families* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Gulfview on 30A, a beautifully designed luxury retreat offering the perfect mix of upscale comfort and laid-back coastal living. This spacious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home is thoughtfully designed for families and groups looking to relax and make unforgettable beach memories. Featuring two stunning king master suites — one conveniently located on the main floor and another upstairs — each offers private porch access where you can enjoy peaceful mornings and refreshing Gulf breezes. The inviting front porch is the perfect spot for coffee or evening conversations, while the large backyard provides plenty of space to unwind, entertain, or soak up the Florida sunshine.Inside, the gourmet kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed to prepare delicious family meals and gather together after a day at the beach. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional guest suites, including a queen bedroom with ensuite bathroom and a bunk room featuring two twin bunk beds and its own ensuite, along with a cozy landing area complete with a sleeper sofa for extra guests.Just four houses away, the neighborhood path leads directly to a spectacular resort-style community pool featuring a whirlpool, grilling area, fire pit with comfortable seating, and a 360-degree observation tower perfect for enjoying sunsets with family and friends. Blue Mountain Beach access is just a short bike ride away, along with several local restaurants and shops. Nestled in a quiet, secluded neighborhood, Gulfview on 30A offers the perfect balance of privacy, luxury, and easy access to everything the Emerald Coast has to offer. Come start making lifelong memories at Gulfview on 30A.Highland Parks in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Park is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom 1: King BedSecond Floor: Master Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsCozy Landing Area: Sleeper Sofa*Parking only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA. *AREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike rentals are available and within walking distance at Big Daddy's Bike Shop (2217 W. Co Hwy 30A) for you to take a ride along scenic 30A.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
